conventions.format: Prettier: no semi, single quotes, width 100, trailingComma all. EditorConfig: 2-space, LF. ESLint 9 flat config (eslint-plugin-vue essential + vue-ts recommended + prettier skip-formatting). Scripts: lint, format, format:check, typecheck, test.
conventions.naming: Package scope @frisson/*. Imports use .ts extensions (native TS on Node >=22.18). API files lowercase/kebab (error-handler.ts); plugins export xPlugin, routes export xRoutes (FastifyPluginAsyncZod), services are plain functions (db, input) such as listCrates/getCrate. Web: PascalCase .vue, useX composables/stores, api/ one file per resource.
conventions.api: app.ts buildApp registers errorHandlerPlugin, authPlugin, dbPlugin, coversPlugin, then routes under /api prefix, webPlugin last. Zod schemas in route schema {params, body, response}. Services throw HttpError/notFound/badRequest (errors.ts); services never touch reply.
conventions.errorShape: { statusCode, error, message, issues? } (ApiError in @frisson/shared); handler order: zod validation 400, response serialization 500, HttpError, fastify 4xx, else 500.
conventions.shared: packages/shared/src/index.ts: zod 4 schemas, input schemas named xInput, entities plain names, inferred types; exports ./ and ./sorting (no zod). Section dividers with box-drawing comments.
conventions.web: Pinia setup stores (library, session) using ref/computed/functions; api/client.ts request<T>() with ApiRequestError and errorMessage(); api modules call request. Stores import api as namespace or named fns.
conventions.tests: Vitest; api tests in apps/api/test, web tests colocated *.test.ts.

documentation.auth: README 'Who can edit' table: ADMIN_PASSWORD set = browse public, editing needs Staff log in; unset in dev/test = open; unset in production = read-only. Logins 30 days, rate limit 10 per 15 min, password change logs everyone out; SESSION_SECRET decouples. Single shared admin password, cookie frisson_session; no per-user accounts. Matches code in plugins/auth.ts.
documentation.adminPassword: Required by compose (:? check), .env.example says deployment refuses to start without it (app itself only goes read-only). DEPLOY.md suggests openssl rand -base64 24; change by editing .env and docker compose up -d.
documentation.deployEnvVars: ADMIN_PASSWORD, DOMAIN (no http:// for real certs), SESSION_SECRET (optional), TRUST_PROXY=true set in compose, DATA_DIR/DATABASE_PATH/COVERS_DIR/WEB_DIR documented in README.
documentation.futureAccounts: Absent. SPEC section 8 only says 'read-only public mode plus a simple admin login'. ADR 0003 says fail closed. No ADR or doc mentions multi-user, accounts or roles. ADR 0001 says single-user collection.
documentation.staleness: DEPLOY.md and README still reference crate-digger: git clone URL github.com/ThomF/crate-digger, cd crate-digger, crate.db, crate-data volume, crate-backup (db filename and volume likely intentional); README title says Frisson. SPEC calls self-hosting '(later)' while README says deployment done.
